audience: merchants with a Shopify store who read and answer customer product reviews

useCases.title: Count reviews and read the newest ones
useCases.text: Count the store's reviews, or the reviews of one product, and filter the count by star rating. Then list the newest reviews to read what customers wrote.

useCases.title: Reply to low-rated reviews
useCases.text: List the low-rated reviews and open each one to read it in full. Then post a public reply to each review you approve. Each reply call adds a new reply that shoppers can see.

useCases.title: Follow up with a reviewer
useCases.text: Open a review by its Judge.me id, then read the reviewer's name and contact details. Use them to follow up with the customer.

useCases.title: Check the store plan and settings
useCases.text: Read the store's Judge.me plan, owner and platform details. Then read selected settings by key, such as autopublish.

useCases.title: Audit the registered webhooks
useCases.text: List the webhooks the store registered with Judge.me, with their URLs and topics. Check that each URL still points to a system you use.
